system.description: You become a living vessel for your deity. Whatever the result, you are Fatigued afterwards and cannot cast spells again until your next Long Rest.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you cannot be Charmed or Frightened while it lasts.
outcomes.success: For the rest of the encounter, your attacks and defence use DR8, your attacks deal 2d12 damage, and you can fly.
outcomes.failure: The god fills you only until the end of your next turn.
outcomes.ruin: Your god finds the vessel wanting, and nothing fills you. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
